Main.Title: SLiveTranslator
Main.UnsavedText: Some settings were changed but not saved. Save them before closing?
Main.SavedWithProblems: Settings saved, but something does not work
Home.Title: Home
Home.SubtitlesHint: Reads the subtitle region and shows the translation over the game.
Home.GoogleBlocked: Google Translate: blocked on this network until {0}; MyMemory translates meanwhile
Home.RecommendTitle: For more free translation, in this order:
Home.Recommend.Email: Add an email for MyMemory (50,000 characters a day instead of 5,000).
Home.Recommend.Gemini: Add a Gemini API key: Gemini has a free tier.
Home.Recommend.DeepL: Add a DeepL API Free key (500,000 characters a month).
Home.Recommend.Claude: For the best names, pronouns and idioms: a Claude API key (paid).
Translation.Title: Translation
Translation.ProviderHint: The free services stay behind the one chosen here and translate whenever it cannot.
Translation.FreeAbout: No key needed. Google is tried first; when it blocks this network, MyMemory translates. Each line is translated alone, so names and pronouns can vary; an API key gives better translations.
Translation.CardsHint: Enter and check any service's key here, before or after picking the service above. A saved key is checked when its card is open.
Translation.UseContextHint: AI services translate a line better when they see the conversation before it.
Translation.EmailHint: Optional: raises MyMemory's free limit from 5,000 to 50,000 characters a day.
Translation.TestHint: Translates this line now with the settings on this page, saved or not. It is a real request and counts toward the service's quota.
Card.KeySaved: Saved. Type a new key to replace it.
Card.KeyUnreadable: The saved key cannot be read on this Windows account. Enter it again.
Card.KeyRemoved: The saved key is removed when you save. Type a key to keep one.
Card.Hint.NeedKey: Enter the API key and press Check.
Card.Hint.NeedAddress: Enter the server address and press Check.
Card.Hint.PressCheck: Press Check, or wait a moment: the list fills in once the key is checked.
Card.Hint.NoModels: This key lists no model that can translate.
Card.SavedModelMissing: The saved model {0} is not on this key's list. It stays selected until you pick another one.
Card.OfflineSavedModel: The saved model {0} will still be used.
Card.EffortHint: Low answers fastest; Medium thinks a little longer about hard lines and costs a little more.
Card.GeminiFreeTier: Gemini has a free tier: a key from Google AI Studio works without payment, within its daily limits. Google may use what is sent on the free tier to improve its products.
Profile.Title: Game profile
Profile.UseHint: Names to keep, the glossary and who speaks to whom. Automatic picks the profile of the game in front.
Profile.SaveFirst: Save or discard the changes to this profile before you pick another one.
Profile.Name: Name
Profile.GridHint: Click a cell to edit it. Saving the profile translates its lines again the next time they appear.
Profile.NoId: the file has no profile id
Profile.SaveFailed: The profile could not be saved: {0}
Profile.ReplaceAsk: A profile with the id "{1}" exists already ({0}). Replace it with the imported one?
Profile.ExportFailed: The profile could not be exported: {0}
Subtitles.Title: Subtitles
Subtitles.RegionHint: Select only the strip where the subtitles appear, not the whole screen. The region is saved right away.
Subtitles.IntervalHint: How often the region is read. Lower reacts faster and uses more CPU.
Subtitles.Pause: Pause while the game is not in front
Subtitles.PauseHint: Reads nothing while you are in another window.
Subtitles.OcrModeHint: Automatic tries both ways and keeps the better reading.
Subtitles.LowImpactHint: Reads at a lower priority, so the game keeps more of the CPU.
Subtitles.GapRatioHint: In line heights (0.7 to 2.5). Raise it if sentences of one subtitle come out split.
Overlay.Title: Appearance
Overlay.PreviewHint: Shows a sample subtitle with the settings on this page for a few seconds, saved or not.
Overlay.MaxLinesHint: How many of the latest lines stay in the box, so a line that went by fast can still be read.
Overlay.ShowOriginalHint: Shows the game's text, smaller, under each translation.
Overlay.LabelSecondsHint: How long the labels of translate screen stay; 0 keeps them until cleared.
Overlay.Sample2: We should find shelter before nightfall.
Overlay.Sample3: Roach is tired, and so am I.
History.Hint: The latest subtitle lines, newest first. Select a line to fix its translation: the fix is used from now on for every service, and the overlay shows it at once.
History.Empty: No subtitle lines yet. Turn on subtitles in the game and the lines appear here.
History.FixHint: Write the translation you want. An original of several lines needs as many lines here.
History.FixLines: The original has {0} lines: write one line of translation for each.
History.NoCache: The cache is not ready yet, so the fix cannot be kept. Try again in a moment.
History.Fixed: Fixed. The overlay shows your translation from now on.
Hotkeys.Title: Hotkeys
Hotkeys.Hint: Click a box and press the new combination. The hotkeys are off while a box is selected, so the current one can be recorded too. Changes apply when you save.
Hotkeys.RecordingHint: Press the new combination. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
Notifications.Title: Notifications
Notifications.TestHint: Shows one notice of each kind that is on, with the settings on this page, saved or not.
Notifications.PositionHint: Where notices appear on the game's screen.
Notifications.SoundHint: Plays the Windows sound of each kind with its notice.
Notifications.BalloonsHint: Windows notifications from the tray icon at start and before the overlay is ready. Windows hides them while a game is in front.
Notifications.BadgeHint: A small marker at the subtitle region while subtitles are on.
Notifications.MuteHint: Hides every notice and sound except errors. Also in the tray menu.
Storage.Title: Storage & cache
Storage.ChangeHint: Settings, cache, game profiles and the log are kept here. Change copies or moves them to another folder.
Storage.PortableHint: Keeps the data next to the program, in {0}, for a copy on a USB drive. API keys must be entered again on another PC.
Storage.Problem.NotFullPath: {0} is not a full folder path.
Storage.Problem.SameFolder: {0} is the folder in use already.
Storage.Problem.InsideCurrent: {0} is inside the folder in use. Pick a folder outside it.
Storage.Problem.InsideAppFolder: {0} is inside the program's folder, which an update can replace. Pick another folder, or turn on Portable.
Storage.Problem.NotWritable: {0} cannot be written to. Pick a folder you can write to.
Storage.Problem.NoSpace: There is not enough free space for the data at {0}.
Storage.Problem.NotEmpty: {0} holds other files. Pick an empty folder, or one that holds SLiveTranslator data.
Storage.HasData: {0} holds SLiveTranslator data already. Use that data, or replace it with the data in use now?
Storage.MoveOrCopy: Move the data from {0} to {1}, or copy it and keep the old folder as it is?
Storage.CopyAsk: Copy the data in use to {0}? The folder it is in now keeps its copy.
Storage.BusySave: Wait until the data folder is copied, then save.
Storage.CopyFailed: The data could not be copied: {0}. Nothing was changed. If a file is in use by another program, close it, or restart SLiveTranslator, and try again.
Storage.PointFailed: The data was copied, but the new folder could not be set: {0}
Storage.LeftBehind: The data is in the new folder, but some files stayed in {0} (in use by another program, or changed after the copy): {1}
Storage.NextStart: From the next start, the data in {0} is used.
Storage.RestartAsk: SLiveTranslator loads the data in {0} when it starts again. Restart now?
Cache.NotLoaded: The cache is not loaded yet.
Cache.MaxEntriesHint: Above this, the translations used least recently are dropped. Hand fixes are always kept.
Cache.ClearHint: Each asks first. A cleared line is translated again the next time it appears, which counts toward the service's quota.
Cache.Clear.Orphans: Remove {0:N0} entries kept under names no service uses any more?
Cache.Clear.NonEdited: Remove {0:N0} entries, keeping only the ones fixed or edited by hand?
Cache.Clear.All: Remove all {0:N0} entries, hand fixes included? This cannot be undone.
Cache.EditHint: Edit a translation to fix it by hand: the fix is used for every service from now on.
Cache.FixLines: A fix needs one line for each line of the original.
Cache.ExportFailed: The cache could not be exported: {0}
Cache.ImportedKept: Imported {0:N0} entries from {1}. Lines you fixed here keep your fix: {2:N0}.
Logs.Title: Log
Logs.Hint: The last 500 lines. Copy diagnostics puts the version, system, data folder, settings (without API keys or email) and the last 100 lines on the clipboard, for a bug report.
Logs.ClearFailed: The log could not be cleared: another program holds it.
Logs.CopyFailed: The clipboard is in use by another program. Try again.
General.Title: General & About
General.LanguageHint: The language of the app's windows, menus and notices. It changes when you save, without a restart.
General.StartupHint: Starts quietly in the tray when you sign in to Windows. Applied at once.
General.StartupFailed: Start with Windows could not be changed: {0}
General.SetupHint: Goes through the first-run steps again: language, translation service, subtitle region and hotkeys.
Welcome.Title: Welcome to SLiveTranslator
Welcome.LanguageText: Choose the language of the app. You can change it later in General & About.
Welcome.ProviderText: The free services need no key. A service with an API key translates names, pronouns and idioms better: enter the key and it is checked right away.
Welcome.RegionText: Let the game show a line of subtitles, then select the strip where they appear.
Welcome.HotkeysText: Press each hotkey: it lights up when it works. While this step shows, they do nothing else.
Welcome.HotkeysLater: Change them any time on the Hotkeys page.
Position.Custom: In a box of its own
Notice.ModeShared: Shared on screen: people watching your screen see the translation
Notice.ModePrivate: Private overlay: only you see the translation
Notice.ModeSharedMoved: It covered the read region, so it shows above it now.
Region.ReadInstruction: Drag a box around the subtitle lines only
Region.ReadHint: Not the whole screen: that is slow and picks up the HUD.
Region.DisplayInstruction: Drag where the translation should appear
Region.DisplayHint: The preview uses your font size from Appearance.
Region.Keys: Arrows move  ·  Shift+arrows resize  ·  Ctrl for 10 px  ·  Tab next monitor  ·  double-click to confirm
Region.KeysDisplay: Arrows move  ·  Shift+arrows resize  ·  edges snap to the read region  ·  Backspace goes back
Region.OutlineHint: Keeps the text readable on bright scenes.
Region.ReadsNothing: No text here yet. Let the game show a line.
Region.ClearOfRead: Clear of the read region  ·  fine for both display modes
Region.CoversShared: Covers the read region  ·  in Shared on screen the lines go above it instead
Region.CoversPrivate: Covers the original subtitles  ·  fine with Private overlay
Regions.Intro: Two boxes on your screen: where the app reads the game's subtitles, and where it shows the translation.
Regions.PreviewName: The read region and the display region on the monitor
Regions.NoRegionYet: No read region yet: pick one on the screen first.
Regions.PickBothHint: The screen dims and you drag two boxes: first around the game's subtitle lines, then where the translation should go. Enter confirms, Esc cancels.
Regions.TestNothing: No text found in the region. Let the game show a subtitle, then test again.
Regions.DisplayHint: Where the translation appears, and the box behind it.
Regions.ClearOfRead: Clear of the read region: works in both display modes.
Regions.CoversShared: Covers the read region. In Shared on screen the app would read its own translation, so the lines go above the region instead.
Regions.CoversPrivate: Covers the original subtitles: fine with Private overlay. In Shared on screen the lines would go above the region.
Display.Intro: Choose who sees the translation when you share your screen, stream or record.
Display.PrivateText: Only you see the translation. It is hidden from screen sharing, recordings and screenshots, and it can sit right on top of the original subtitles.
Display.SharedText: The translation becomes part of your screen, so people in Discord, Teams, Meet or OBS see it too. It needs a display region apart from the read region.
Display.ShareSubtitlesHint: The translated lines in the display region.
Display.ShareLabelsHint: The labels drawn over menus, items and tooltips.
Display.ShareNoticesHint: "Subtitles ON", errors, quota warnings and the live badge. Usually best kept to yourself.
Display.WholeScreen: Viewers see the translation when you share your whole screen. Sharing only the game window leaves it out, because the translation is drawn in a window of its own.
Display.PrivateNote: People watching your screen see the game without any translation. Pick Shared on screen to show it to them, and choose which parts they see.
Display.HideMain: Hide this window from screen sharing
Display.HideMainHint: A shared desktop never shows your settings or API key fields.
Display.HotkeyHint: A notice on the game screen says which mode is on. Change it on the Hotkeys page.
Timing.Intro: How long each translated line stays on screen, and how it leaves.
Timing.TimelineHint: An 80-character line the game shows for 3 seconds.
Timing.TimelineEndNext: fades out over {0} when the next line comes
Timing.StayTitle: After the game hides the line
Timing.StayHint: Keep the translation on screen so fast dialog can still be read.
Timing.ByLengthExample: Your reading speed: an {0}-character line stays {1}.
Timing.UntilNextHint: Nothing disappears by itself; Clear removes it.
Timing.MinHint: Short lines such as "Yes." do not flash by, even when the game hides them fast.
Timing.BarHint: A thin line under the translation shrinks until it fades.
Timing.FadeHint: 0 shows and hides the lines at once.
Timing.PushHint: Keeps up to {0} lines (Lines shown, on Appearance).
Timing.ReplaceHint: Only the newest line is on screen.
Timing.ClearText: Clear the text, keep subtitles on
Timing.ClearTextHint: The next line shows as usual.
Home.StatusOn: On  ·  following the dialog  ·  {0} lines this session
Home.StatusOff: Off  ·  press {0} or flip the switch to start
Home.Place.Custom: Shows in a box of its own
Home.ModePrivateText: Only you see the translation. It is hidden from screen sharing, recordings and screenshots.
Home.ModeSharedText: The translation is part of your screen: people watching a screen share or a recording see it too.
Home.StayLabel: Stays after the game hides it
Overlay.MovedHint: Where the translation goes and its background are on Subtitles › Regions; how long it stays is on Subtitles › Timing.
